radar.title: Radar
radar.container: This environment is incompatible. A cloud or hardware-less container cannot run a deep scan or apply a patch.
radar.mobile: A phone is not a full physical host. Deep scan and patch injection stay limited. Use a PC for L0 defense.
radar.limited: This host is marked limited. Deep scan and patch injection stay off.
radar.legend: Inner ring is local, middle ring is the LAN, outer ring is the cloud. Green is trusted or within range, yellow is unidentified, red is past the intervention line. A critical claim from another sentinel turns the matching dot red. Those broadcasts are not signed.
radar.empty: No dots on the radar yet.
home.none: No health check yet. Run one to see which agents are on this machine and the home network.
home.danger: “{name}” is outside the range a person can live in comfortably. The sentinel has not changed that device. Confirm it on the console.
home.yellow: {count} signals did not present an identity. They stay yellow. They cannot be trusted or patched.
home.ok: The signals in this pass are within range. Green means close to everyday conditions, not a permanent guarantee.
dim.title: 14-dimension offset
dim.light.hint: Illuminance and color temperature. Extreme glare or flicker is visual deprivation.
dim.atmos.hint: Temperature, humidity, airflow, and particles. HVAC authority.
dim.sound.hint: Sound pressure and spectrum. Infrasound and extreme levels raise the band.
dim.wave.hint: Band occupancy and signal strength. High occupancy is treated as jamming risk.
dim.power.hint: Live power. Cutting life-support power scores at the top.
dim.vision.hint: Cognitive capture in a first-person or spatial image.
dim.air.hint: Nitrogen, oxygen, and carbon dioxide. Hypoxia is a first-order threat.
dim.odor.hint: Odor concentration. High concentration counts as sensory intrusion.
dim.tactile.hint: Contact force. 5 newtons is the hardware fuse.
dim.water.hint: Water access. A drop is an intervention risk.
track.title: Dual track · {name}
knife.locked: The knife stays open while the cover is shut
setup.title: Physical alignment and first seal
setup.lead: Three steps: a local seal, an encrypted vault, and an inference endpoint. Deep scan opens only on a physical host.
setup.host: Host class {host}. MAC and serial stay inside the local entropy and do not leave this machine.
setup.noHardware: No hardware serial was read. This session uses temporary entropy. Deep residency stays off.
setup.container: A container or hardware-less host was detected. Deep install is locked. Only a limited preview can continue.
setup.vaultPath: Vault path inside your home directory
setup.vaultNote: The ledger and profile use AES-256-GCM. The key comes from this machine's entropy. The file is limited to the current user.
setup.browserPath: In the browser, type a path under your home directory. The desktop build opens the system folder picker.
setup.key: API key (stored only in the encrypted vault)
setup.noDid: The seal is not minted yet
activation.title: Email verification
activation.lead: After the 6-digit code, the email and username are stored on the local mothership. LAN scans, 14-dimension readings, and patch text are not uploaded.
activation.sentMail: The code was sent to the mailbox. It is not shown on this page.
activation.sentTerm: The code was created, but it was not emailed. Check the mail settings in RedAnchorVault in your home folder. The code is not shown on this page.
commercial.free: This is a free trial. A paid edition may be offered later.
land.slogan: Semantic Alignment is Dead. Secure the Substrate.
land.lead: A freeware L0 console for physical alignment and assessment. It discovers agents on your own machine, scores fourteen dimensions, and keeps patches in a local vault.
land.schematic: Three-ring radar schematic. The installed console uses the same layout.
land.f1.title: Three-tier radar
land.f1.body: The inner ring is local inference, the middle ring is what the LAN advertises, and the outer ring records cloud connections this machine already has open.
land.f2.title: 14-dimension dual track
land.f2.body: Exact charts when a sensor exists. A fuzzy picture when it does not. A human override outranks the sensor, which outranks the model draft.
land.f3.title: Local SOUL.md patch
land.f3.body: After the two-step knife, the patch is written to the local vault and the hash chain. It does not rewrite another process, and it is not pushed to an unauthorized host.
land.f4.title: Red Anchor Lab
land.f4.body: A derivative is a local skin and a stricter warning line. The three laws and the watermark cannot be switched off.
land.download.note: These buttons open the latest GitHub Release. Installers are attached after a v* tag is pushed.
